results.name: seven card definitions and unchanged starter/AI deck contents
all new instances initialize effect state and share negative-status helpers
Aria recovers one real grave as a fresh unbuffed instance
Aria uses printed cost and excludes the same name
Aria cannot duplicate an S12-returned grave record
Aria cannot duplicate a Maria-returned grave record
fixed new effects ignore S04 and preserve C15 pending multiplier
ST summon counter consumes one effect while Nox SP bypasses that counter
Nox stops one of two Marguerites and expires after the next enemy turn
Nox has backline-only choices without Aria and respects status immunity
Nox plus Aria can stop a frontline periodic skill without disabling guard or attacks
periodic stop covers auto awakening but not forced S05 awakening
periodic stop covers secondary C25 end buff and harmful end abilities
C50 and C56 cleanse periodic stop using shared status helpers
Stellaria move retains instance, buffs, statuses and attack-used state
Stellaria swaps lanes without resummon or extra draw
Stellaria excludes self and never advances back-only C51/C15
Stellaria choice can be skipped or invalidated without moving cards
Seraphina blocks all S03 harms once and repeated protection does not stack
Seraphina protects only one target of S06 and blocks S14 DEF zero
Seraphina protection expires at the next enemy end and persists after source retreat
Seraphina does not intercept C51 character damage
Galdio intercepts nonlethal C51 damage before DEF once per enemy turn
actual Marguerite start skill transfers damage to a periodic-stopped Galdio
Galdio requires a character-skill source, a rear target, and a non-transferred packet
two Galdios never serially absorb the same damage and can cover distinct hits
Galdio preserves ignoreDef and a transferred hit cannot redirect to C25
Galdio does not intercept normal attacks, own-turn damage, or when silenced
Neiras adds only backline targets through guard and preserves DEF absorption
Neiras can turn a ready ATK3 attack into a guarded Marguerite removal
Neiras preserves summon sickness and unused routes expire
Neiras route is consumed by normal guard attacks and native C01 extra attacks
Neiras route is consumed by S08 reflection and Seraphina does not prevent reflection
new automatic choices grant a usable Neiras route during main phase
Kanon summon cleans all statuses without restoring combat values or triggering bind damage
Kanon active cleanse spends one energy once per turn and ignores attack-used/periodic stop
Kanon cannot actively cleanse when stunned, silenced or lacking energy; skip is free
Kanon active commands are gated by phase, turn, busy and pending actions
Kanon active ST counter consumes energy/use but leaves target status
Kanon cleansing after start does not replay a skipped Marguerite shot

limitations: DOM/audio/visual timing are stubbed; browser interaction and rendering are not tested.
